data.sentence: Hi Philip, hi Danielle — thanks for joining. Rachel's with me again.
Thanks Lisa. Good news up front: Danielle and I met yesterday, and we want to move forward with Detect.
That's wonderful to hear. Thank you.
I'll be honest about how we got here, because it wasn't a given. I had real reservations after the March outage.
A CISO adding a monitoring platform that went dark for six hours is not an easy sell to my board.
What changed my mind was the game day summary you sent. Showing us what failed in your own testing, not just what passed, built a lot of credibility.
I'm really glad that landed. Our engineering team was nervous about sharing the network partition result.
That was the part I trusted most. Every vendor tells me they're resilient. You showed me where you weren't, and what you're doing about it.
The other factor is consolidation. We're on Comply and Protect already, and we're trying to cut down our tool count.
Comply v2 saved us around sixty hours on our last HIPAA cycle. Adding Detect on the same platform gives us one evidence trail.
That's a big part of the design — Detect alerts and response actions flow straight into Comply as audit evidence.
That's exactly what I want to see working. How long is the onboarding?
For your size, about four weeks. The first week is a seven-day observation mode where Detect learns your baselines without paging anyone.
Good. That observation period matters to me — I don't want my team buried in alerts on day one.
On terms, we'd add Detect to your existing three-year agreement, so it co-terms with Comply and Protect.
For the first year, we'll include the enhanced 99.9 SLA and the pipeline health panel as soon as it's released in June.
That's what we discussed, and it works for us.
One request: I'd like the heartbeat alert routed to our SOC from day one, even before the panel ships.
The internal heartbeat goes live at the end of this month. I'll check whether we can expose the alert to customers early, starting with you.
If you can, that would make Keystone a happy reference customer.
We'd love that. Philip, what do you need from us to get this through procurement?
A revised order form and the security questionnaire update for Detect. Legal's turnaround is about a week.
I'll send both by Friday.
And I'll set up the onboarding kickoff for the week of June eighth, assuming the paperwork lands.
Sounds great. Honestly, this is the most confident I've felt about a security vendor decision in a while.
Agreed. Thanks to you both — you've been straight with us the whole way.
Thank you, Philip, Danielle. We're excited to have you on Detect.
